name: GitHub webhooks
description: Lets a webhook channel take GitHub's repository and organization events.
author: Seti

channelSources.title: GitHub
channelSources.description: Repository or organization webhooks: workflow runs, deployments, pull requests, issues.
channelSources.setup: In GitHub, add a webhook on the repository or organization with the URL, content type application/json and the secret, and pick the events to send, such as workflow runs, deployments and pull requests. GitHub signs with X-Hub-Signature-256.
